content:
Ben Carter: Need quick alignment on LinkedIn ads targeting + budget for the regulated ABM pilot. Threading here so we can lock before Tyler builds campaigns. Creative brief draft is here (WIP): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abm-regulated-linkedin-creative

Ben Carter: Proposal: 2 campaigns (FinServ + Healthcare), each with 2 ad sets (Security persona + Platform/ML persona). Geo: US/Canada + UK/Ireland + DACH (unless we think it’s too thin).

Tyler Benson: :eyes: got it. Before I build, we should sanity-check audience sizes. LinkedIn gets real low-volume if we stack: industry + seniority + job titles + company size + geo.

Soojin Lee: +1. Also reminder: don’t use “HIPAA-ready” language in ad copy. “Supports private/VPC deployments + auditability controls” is approved.

Grace O'Connor: From outbound experience: Security titles vary a lot. If we only pick “CISO” we’ll miss Directors/Heads who actually show up to the first meeting.

Ben Carter: OK, what’s the recommended title list for Security + Platform? Want it tight enough to be relevant but not 500 people total.

Tyler Benson: I’d do job functions first (Information Technology + Engineering) and layer seniorities. Titles as “include” not “only.”

Tyler Benson: Security persona (suggested Includes):
- Chief Information Security Officer
- VP Information Security
- Head of Information Security
- Director, Information Security
- Director, Security Engineering
- Security Architect
- GRC Manager / Director (only if we have enough volume)

Tyler Benson: Platform persona (suggested Includes):
- VP Engineering
- Director of Engineering
- Head of Platform Engineering
- Platform Engineering Manager
- ML Engineering Manager
- Director of Machine Learning
- Head of MLOps
- Principal/Staff Engineer (optional)

Ethan Wallace: For FinServ specifically, “Risk” titles sometimes bite (model risk mgmt). But that might be a different message/CTA. Probably keep this pilot to Security + Platform.

Ben Carter: Agree. We can handle “Risk/Model Governance” in 1:1 follow-ups.

Isabelle Laurent: If we do two verticals + two personas + three regions, that’s already 12 segments. Might be fine, but we should keep reporting readable. UTMs need to encode vertical/persona/geo at least.

Camila Reyes: What’s the budget split assumption? And are we optimizing for form fills or meeting booked?

Ben Carter: Budget strawman: $12k over 3 weeks initial test. Goal is meetings booked (security review call / architecture consult), but we’ll likely use lead gen form or landing page + “book time.”

Tyler Benson: If we optimize for “Book a meeting” off-platform, LinkedIn algo sometimes struggles early. Alternative: use LinkedIn Lead Gen form w/ 4 fields + route to HubSpot + immediate calendar link in thank-you screen.

Grace O'Connor: Please do not send me unqualified “downloaders” :)

Ben Carter: lol. We’ll gate with the form question: “Deployment need: Hosted / Dedicated / Private (VPC/on-prem)” + “Are you handling regulated data?”

Soojin Lee: Make sure the question wording doesn’t imply we are certifying their workload. More like: “Do you have compliance / data residency requirements?”

Tyler Benson: On low-volume: when I mock this in LinkedIn, Healthcare + DACH + “CISO” gets tiny. Like <1k. That will throttle.

Ben Carter: So what’s the recommendation? Drop DACH? Broaden titles? Or broaden industry?

Tyler Benson: I’d recommend:
1) Keep NA + UK/Ireland for both verticals.
2) Add DACH only for FinServ platform persona (tends to have more volume) OR run DACH as a separate small test later.
3) Use Industries: “Banking” + “Financial Services” + “Insurance” for FinServ; “Hospital & Health Care” + “Medical Practice” + “Health, Wellness & Fitness” (careful) for Healthcare.
4) Company size: 200–10,000 (if we go 1k+ only, volume drops fast).

Isabelle Laurent: +1. Also, for measurement, fewer geos is better. We can still tag EMEA intent from website visits separately.

Camila Reyes: I’m comfortable with $12k test if we’re honest about likely lead volume. What’s our expected output? Roughly.

Ben Carter: Rough guess: CTR 0.4–0.8%, landing CVR 2–4%, meeting conversion 10–20% of form fills if SDR follows up fast. So maybe 15–30 leads, 3–8 meetings if things go well.

Grace O'Connor: That’s fine as long as SDR follow-up SLA is <15 mins during business hours. Otherwise it dies.

Ben Carter: Noted. We’ll set an SLA in the pilot ops doc.

Tyler Benson: UTMs — proposal to standardize:
- utm_source=linkedin
- utm_medium=paid_social
- utm_campaign=abm_regulated_wk3 (or abm_regulated_2025q2)
- utm_content={vertical}_{persona}_{geo}_{creative}
Example: utm_content=finserv_security_na_carouselA

Isabelle Laurent: Please also add utm_term for targeting type:
- utm_term=jobtitle
- utm_term=jobfunction_seniority
So we can compare “tight titles” vs “broader function” later.

Tyler Benson: Works. One caveat: LinkedIn won’t dynamically fill job title into utm_term. We’ll set it at ad set level.

Soojin Lee: Also ensure the landing page has the same framing as the ads:
- “Dedicated capacity or Private (VPC/on‑prem) for regulated workloads”
- bullets: audit logs, SSO/SAML, retention controls, KMS/HSM
No absolute claims.

Ethan Wallace: CTA preference? “Get the security FAQ + evidence pack index” vs “Book a security review call”?

Ben Carter: Concern: evidence pack CTA will attract vendors + students. My vote: primary CTA = “Book a 20-min architecture + security review” and secondary link to FAQ.

Camila Reyes: Agree. Keep evidence pack behind a human step.

Grace O'Connor: :thumbsup: Also can we exclude current customers + employees from ads?

Tyler Benson: Yep. I’ll upload suppression lists (customers, open opps, employees). Need Isabelle to export latest customer domains.

Isabelle Laurent: I’ll send a CSV of domains by EOD.

Ben Carter: Final call on regions:
- NA (US/CA): 60%
- UK/Ireland: 25%
- DACH: 15% (FinServ platform only)
Does that work?

Tyler Benson: Yes, but I’d rather do NA 70 / UKI 30 for week 1, then add DACH if we’re not starving. Otherwise we split too early.

Camila Reyes: +1 to staged rollout. Keep it simple week 1.

Ben Carter: OK. Action items:
- Tyler: build campaigns with NA + UKI only, two verticals, two personas, staged geo expansion. Use Lead Gen form + meeting link.
- Soojin/Ethan: finalize copy variants by tomorrow noon (approved language only).
- Isabelle: send suppression domains CSV.
- Grace: confirm SDR routing + follow-up SLA.

Tyler Benson: I’ll also post audience size estimates once built so we can spot any <5k segments.

Soojin Lee: Dropping copy notes in the brief doc now. :writing_hand:

Grace O'Connor: I’ll align w/ Rohan on fast follow-up + a short qualifying script for “Private vs Dedicated.”

Ben Carter: Perfect. Thanks all.
